thread:
maria: Quick sync — Pioneer Health pilot kickoff: integration deliverables & timeline. Need owners and any blockers by EOD Wed. Summary below.

maria: High-level asks from Pioneer: API integration, SSO, certs for mTLS, staging perf runs, and an eval harness. Sales already passed expected peak: ~20 rps.

raj: I can own the API integration and token flow. Will draft auth contract and a stub client by Tue.

kelly: I'll take SSO + cert configuration. Need Pioneer to share IdP metadata and ACS URL. @maria can you nudge them? :pray:

david: Infra lead here — I'll provision a dedicated staging hostpool and set up VPC peering. Planning one g4dn-equivalent pool; confirm if quantized model is final so we size correctly. ETA Thu AM for peering.

sam: Quick infra question: which model variant are we pinning for the trial? quantized-v3 or fp16? This will affect mem/cpu.

maria: Pioneer verbally okayed gpt-open-legacy-3b-quant (sales note). They said cost sensitivity > raw perf, so quantized seems right.

annie: I'll own the E2E test plan and success criteria. Proposed basic SLOs: p50 latency < 400ms, p95 < 1.2s, and eval accuracy >= 92% on the supplied dataset. Anyone object?

raj: No objections. For auth they also want mTLS option. I can add mTLS support to the proxy but need their certs/key by Tue morning.

kelly: Security/Compliance check — @david can you create a sec-review ticket? We need a quick review for data handling and cert rotation.

david: Filing ticket now -> SEC-PH-115. Requested reviewers: @kelly, @ops-bot. ETA Fri COB for initial review.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy window for Pioneer trial staging is 2024-07-24 02:00-04:00 UTC (auto-scheduled).

maria: Also need Pioneer to provide a 200-300 sample prompt set + ground-truth labels for the eval harness. @annie can you draft the harness and share a template?

annie: Yep. I'll draft and include an example run command:
```bash
python eval.py --model gpt-open-legacy-3b-quant --input samples.jsonl --output results.csv --max-threads 8
```
I'll aim to share the repo link by Wed noon.

sam: Small prod note: PR #342 contains the api-client changes for token refresh. @raj once you review and approve I can merge and cut a test build.

raj: Reviewing PR now — one nit: bump default timeout to 35s (client side) and add retry for 429.

sam: Good catch. Pushed change and added a short changelog entry.

maria: Thank you. I'll consolidate owners + deadlines into the sales handoff doc tomorrow morning and ping Pioneer for outstanding items (IdP metadata, mTLS certs, sample prompts). If anything blocks you, drop it here. :slightly_smiling_face:
